claims.text: Introducing controlled porosity through a designed microstructure architecture will reduce the density of as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
Introducing controlled porosity will preserve the strong room-temperature mechanical performance of as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
Introducing controlled porosity will preserve the strong high-temperature mechanical performance of as-cast HfMoTaTiZr.
Optimized grain size and phase distribution are the structural mediators of the proposed intervention.
A combination of optimized grain size, optimized phase distribution, and controlled porosity will minimize trade-offs among yield strength, fracture toughness, and density.
The intervention is predicted to reduce density by at least 5% relative to the as-cast baseline.
Room-temperature yield strength is predicted to remain within 10% of the as-cast baseline.
Yield strength at 1000 °C is predicted to remain within 10% of the as-cast baseline.
Room-temperature fracture toughness is predicted to remain within 10% of the as-cast baseline.
Fracture toughness at 1000 °C is predicted to remain within 10% of the as-cast baseline.
The density of the as-cast HfMoTaTiZr baseline is 10.21 g cm−3.
The room-temperature yield strength of the as-cast HfMoTaTiZr baseline is 1600 MPa.
The yield strength of the as-cast HfMoTaTiZr baseline at 1000 °C is 855 MPa.
The proposed operating boundary extends from room temperature to 1600 °C.
The experiment will measure density, yield strength, and fracture toughness relative to an as-cast baseline.
A density reduction below 3% is defined to falsify the hypothesis.
A yield-strength reduction greater than 15% at room temperature or 1000 °C is defined to falsify the hypothesis.
A fracture-toughness reduction greater than 15% at room temperature or 1000 °C is defined to falsify the hypothesis.
